notice.title: Notification regarding selection of suitable candidates for the post of Court Master (Shorthand), on deputation basis in the Supreme Court of India.

limits.evidence: Age Requirement The age of the candidate should not exceed 56 years, as on the closing date of receipt of applications

pay.evidence: The post of Court Master (Shorthand) is placed in Level 11 of Pay Matrix, i.e., Rs.67,700 – Rs.2,08,700/- with initial basic pay of Rs.67,700/- plus allowances, as admissible under the Rules
